hooks.command:
stderr_tmp="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$stderr_tmp"' EXIT
start_s="$(date +%s)"
bun run "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/validate-bash-command.js" 2>"$stderr_tmp"
code=$?
end_s="$(date +%s)"
if [ "$code" = "0" ] || [ "$code" = "2" ]; then exit "$code"; fi
mkdir -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.blackhole/hook-events" 2>/dev/null
worktree="$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true)"
elapsed_s=$(( end_s - start_s ))
if [ "$elapsed_s" -ge 4 ]; then kind="timeout"; else kind="crash"; fi
stderr_tail="$(tail -c 300 "$stderr_tmp" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\0')"
events_dir="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.blackhole/hook-events"
record_tmp="$(mktemp "$events_dir/.hook-exec-error.XXXXXX" 2>/dev/null || true)"
record_written=0
if [ -n "$record_tmp" ]; then
  HOOK_RECORDED_AT="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
  HOOK_NAME="validate-bash-command" \
  HOOK_TOOL="Bash" \
  HOOK_CODE="$code" \
  HOOK_WORKTREE="$worktree" \
  HOOK_KIND="$kind" \
  HOOK_STDERR_TAIL="$stderr_tail" \
  bun -e 'const e=process.env;const t=e.HOOK_STDERR_TAIL;process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({version:2,recorded_at:e.HOOK_RECORDED_AT,hook:e.HOOK_NAME,tool:e.HOOK_TOOL||null,decision:"allow",tier:"error",pattern_id:"hook-exec-failure",reason:"validator process exited "+e.HOOK_CODE+" before producing a decision",worktree:e.HOOK_WORKTREE||null,detail:"process exit code "+e.HOOK_CODE+" ("+e.HOOK_KIND+")"+(t?": "+t:""),agent_id:null,agent_type:null}));' > "$record_tmp" 2>/dev/null
  gen=$?
  if [ "$gen" = "0" ] && [ -s "$record_tmp" ] && mv "$record_tmp" "$events_dir/hook-exec-error-$(date +%s%N).json" 2>/dev/null; then record_written=1; fi
  rm -f "$record_tmp" 2>/dev/null
fi
if [ "$record_written" = "1" ]; then note="see .blackhole/hook-events/"; else note="record NOT written to .blackhole/hook-events/"; fi
echo "[blackhole-hook] validate-bash-command: validator process exited $code before producing a decision — call allowed (fail-open); $note" >&2
exit 0
